articulos.titulo: Argentine fintech Rebill raises $5.4M Pre Series A round
articulos.texto: Rebill, Argentine payments infrastructure founded in 2020, raised $5.4M pre Series A (Tiger Global, Y Combinator, SV Angel). Lets businesses accept local payment methods across Argentina, Brazil, Chile, Colombia, Mexico and the US without a local entity. Between January and September 2026 it quadrupled active merchants and tripled monthly payment volume.

articulos.titulo: iFood acquires Brazilian HR and benefits startup Caju
articulos.texto: iFood Beneficios acquired Caju, a Brazilian benefits startup.

articulos.titulo: EFY Finance secures investment from Tether to expand across Latin America
articulos.texto: Panama-based fintech EFY Finance secured an investment from Tether in its seed round. Cross-border payments, digital asset custody and stablecoin accounts. Licensed in El Salvador, more than 25,000 active accounts, local settlement in 17 countries.

articulos.titulo: Dapta raises $6M seed round led by Chingona Ventures
articulos.texto: Colombian AI startup Dapta raised a $6M seed. AI agents that automate sales via WhatsApp and phone. Over 200,000 registered users; clients include Rappi, Mercado Libre and Siigo.

articulos.titulo: Alice raises $40M Series D led by IFC
articulos.texto: Brazilian healthtech Alice raised a Series D.

Uruguayan Scanntech raises $180M round led by L Catterton
articulos.texto: Uruguayan retail data company Scanntech, founded in 1992, raised $180M led by L Catterton.

articulos.titulo: Argentine Giraffe Bio raises $6.4M seed round to improve copper recovery
articulos.texto: Argentine biotech Giraffe Bio, founded in 2024, raised a $6.4M seed. Uses AI and biotechnology to develop reagents that help mining companies recover more copper. Operates in Chile; plans industrial trials.

articulos.titulo: Flai raises $27M Series A to expand AI agents for US car dealerships
articulos.texto: San Francisco based Flai, founded by Uruguayans, raised a Series A.

articulos.titulo: Colombian fintech Fronte raises pre-seed round led by Rally Cap VC and Bankless Ventures
articulos.texto: Colombian fintech Fronte raised an undisclosed pre-seed. Platform for transnational families to manage household expenses, coordinate payments and build a shared financial history to access credit. Surveyed nearly 1,000 remittance-receiving households; will expand its team in Bogota.
